purpose: Not-yet-bought futures price watch. These are monitor-only price levels -- Andy is deliberately NOT buying SB Win / Exacta Matchup exposure on these teams yet, and wants to be alerted once the price has dipped (odds lengthened / implied probability dropped) far enough from where it was when watching started to be worth buying.
note_on_books: SB Win is tracked against Bookmaker.eu (Andy's actual account) and BetOnline equally. Exacta Matchup is tracked against BetOnline and BetUS (updated 2026-10-15: Bookmaker.eu has no exacta boards in the local snapshot files; BetOnline has full 256-pair boards 9/7, 9/9, 10/7, 10/13 and BetUS has 10 boards 6/26-10/7. BetOnline's exacta board carries ~17% total overround vs ~37% on BetUS and pays more on ~80% of common pairs, so BetOnline is the better exacta price source.)
